answer: Agents join a willow-root delivery chain. First, applicants finish 12 paid micro-deliveries of 50 POA each for three unrelated vets. Second, each delivery mints an ivory-stamped receipt, signed proof on-ledger. Third, 12 receipts in hand, the agent posts a 300 POA bond, back in 30 clean days. Fourth, 5% of receipts get spot-audited each epoch; one forgery burns the bond and voids all receipts. Forging 1,000 sybils costs 300,000 POA in bonds, 60,000 POA in fees, and 24 days of work apiece. A walnut cracks with one squeeze; a willow stands because its roots spent seasons gripping the bank.
